summary: There are few dedicated vEDS programs in the results, so the strongest fits are experts with many vEDS papers (Peter Byers in Seattle and Dianna Milewicz in Houston) and the vEDS-specific groups FIGHT vEDS and We Are vEDS. Two recruiting studies name vEDS as their condition, one in Texas and one in California. The Johns Hopkins connective tissue clinic in Baltimore is the nearest program to Ohio in this set, though its page does not name vEDS. None of the experts shows a direct contact path, so reaching them would start with each institution's main office or a clinic referral.
